purpose: Концепт новой соперницы из Санкт-Петербурга. Концепты сохранены отдельно от игровых спрайтов.

prompts.character:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a single polished standalone character concept for the browser armwrestling game Armwrestling Club.
INPUT ROLES: The TWO user-attached photographs show the SAME woman and are the ONLY identity references. The illustrated long dark-haired woman in a cream sweater is ONLY a rendering/style reference, NOT the new character's identity, hairstyle or clothing. The brick bar illustration is ONLY a game-world palette and contour reference.
Create a recognizably faithful illustrated version of the woman in the two photographs: preserve her specific facial proportions, cheek contours, eyebrow and eye shapes, nose and lips. Hair has dark brown roots transitioning to long sandy blonde ends, natural loose hair with the reference parting; retain her natural physique rather than exaggerated bodybuilder anatomy. Small gold hoop earrings. A fitted simple BLACK short-sleeved top, fully opaque and suitable for sport. Calm confident direct gaze with a subtle competitive expression.
Front-facing waist-up seated opponent concept, camera at seated player's eye level. Her own RIGHT elbow is on an implied armwrestling table, right forearm upright and right hand ready to grip, naturally placed on the viewer's LEFT. Her own LEFT forearm rests in a relaxed pose towards the viewer's RIGHT, left hand naturally gripping a simple vertical table handle. Show the complete face, hair, shoulders, both arms and hands. Five anatomically coherent fingers on each visible hand; no player's hand yet. No actual table, scene or backdrop in this standalone concept.
STYLE: closely match the existing cream-sweater opponent illustration: polished hand-drawn comic game art, expressive accurate face, crisp dark brown outlines (#3b1d14), clean warm skin colors, hard-edged mid and deep shadow shapes, subtle line detailing on hair, limited small highlights; saturated but controlled colors. The existing scene uses warm maroon, orange and cream with strong outlines. Preserve resemblance through this style, not a photographic face pasted onto a cartoon body. No 3D, anime, painterly blur or photoreal texture.
One character only, generous breathing room around silhouette, portrait framing, truly transparent background. No text, logo, watermark, collage, annotations, duplicated person or props beyond the table handle.

backgrounds.detail: SCENE: broad Neva riverside promenade at cool blue evening twilight. A recognizable low multi-span Palace Bridge crosses the middle distance, river reflections, granite embankment with simple cast-iron railing at the sides, historic pale cream and muted terracotta riverside facades at the lateral edges. Place the bridge low and distant so the central upper space remains blue twilight sky. Amber street lamps towards the two sides, subtle mauve clouds. Intimate street-game setting without any people. Contrast cool evening river blues with warm amber highlights.

Translate its crisp bold dark-brown contours, flat color regions with two hard-edged shadow levels, illustrative surface line details, saturated maroon/orange/cream accents into a Saint Petersburg outdoor environment with restrained blue cool tones. No photographic rendering, no 3D, no painting blur.
Composition: a single wide horizontal image with EXACT 16:9 aspect ratio, ideally 2560x1440. Seated-player eye level, perspective compatible with viewing an opponent across a foreground armwrestling table. The table and opponent will be separate future layers: do NOT draw any table, player, person, hand, furniture, armwrestling equipment, UI or frame. Keep the central vertical 35% calm and uncluttered, with only low-detail distant architectural or sky shapes; dominant architectural motifs at the left and right. Lower third is subdued foreground ground/water-edge without high-contrast clutter. Background itself is completely opaque.
No lettering, signs, words, logos, watermarks, collage or multiple panels. Recognizable Petersburg atmosphere, coherent perspective and scale. Evening slate-blue sky strip above, warm ochre/cream window light, burgundy brown pavement below. backgrounds.detail: SCENE: a Saint Petersburg narrow canal during a luminous white night. Historic pastel cream, dusty rose and pale ochre facades line both sides, clean receding perspective towards a small distant low arched bridge, muted wrought iron rails at sides, lilac-blue pearl sky. Still canal water reflects the facades in simplified crisp graphic shapes. Slight peach horizon glow without soft painterly effects. Bright but subdued central vanishing area around sky/water, buildings concentrated at lateral edges, foreground an understated granite quay at bottom so a separate game table can later cover it. No boats, crowds or additional focal subjects.

prompts.scene:
Use case: compositing / stylized-concept. Create ONE finished armwrestling game scene concept, horizontal 16:9, viewed from the seated player's first-person perspective.
INPUTS: Image 1 is the newly created specific blonde woman character and the authoritative identity, clothing and character drawing reference. Image 2 is the authoritative Neva evening background. Preserve her facial likeness, dark brown roots with blonde ends, brown eyes, natural facial proportions, small gold earrings and fitted opaque black short-sleeved top. Preserve the cool blue Neva, low bridge, amber lamps and distant historic Petersburg buildings from background reference. Both inputs are newly generated artwork, compose them into a coherent scene.
Composition: the woman sits directly opposite the player at a broad wooden armwrestling table filling approximately the lower 30% of the frame. Her face is clearly visible near the upper center, with a calm confident slightly competitive expression. Face and hair must not be obscured by the hands. Her own RIGHT elbow is planted on a red padded elbow block at the far side on the viewer's LEFT; her right forearm bends upward and inward to the centered grip. The player's ONLY working right forearm enters from the LOWER RIGHT foreground with a simple red wristband, elbow nearer the player, and its hand firmly interlocks with the woman's right hand at center. Two distinct anatomically connected arms and precisely two hands in this central grip; natural five-finger anatomy, plausible thumb placement, no duplicated fists, no extra limbs. Her own LEFT hand on the viewer's RIGHT grips a single metal vertical table handle, elbow/forearm naturally resting on the table. A blue elbow cushion sits at the near player's side. Neutral opening armwrestling position, no pin yet.
The woman is the focal point with warm skin against the cooler sky. Buildings remain towards lateral edges, bridge lower and behind shoulders, no background objects covering her face. Wooden tabletop with clean comic outline and subtle plank detail, pads in the same polished illustrated style.
STYLE: precisely maintain the game illustrations' crisp dark brown contours, stylized hard-edged shadows and clean colored comic shapes. Detailed illustrative face and hair as in supplied character, not photorealism. Camera at natural seated eye height across table, sensible perspective, coherent scale and lighting. The woman looks at player/viewer.
Full opaque background. NO text, interface, health bars, labels, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, frame, split-screen or other people. Do not show the player's face or torso. Single standalone landscape illustration.
